description: T-4130: does Excel for the web open a pivot filter that carries the autoFilter children and filter attributes Excel itself writes only for sheet filters or OLAP, and does it still apply the filter? The data are t4130-pivot-label-filters'. Each sheet is one builder-v2 pivot at A3, rows Product (FTwo: Region then Product), Sum of Sales: FIcon captionEqual Cherry whose criterion is an iconFilter (3Arrows, 0); FVals one whose criterion is a values list `<filters blank=1 calendarType=none><filter val=Cherry/>`; FDgi one whose criterion is a dateGroupItem (2024-04-17, every part, dateTimeGrouping day); FBtn captionEqual Cherry with filterColumn hiddenButton 1 showButton 0; FSort the same with an autoFilter sortState (ref, columnSort, caseSensitive, sortMethod) and a sortCondition (ref, descending, sortBy, customList, iconSet, iconId); FMeta the same with filter name and description; FMp captionEqual Cherry with mpFld 0; FEo with evalOrder 0; FMf1 and FMf0 a captionNotEqual Apple and a valueGreaterThan 5 filter on Product, with multipleFieldFilters 1 and 0; FTwo a captionEqual West filter on Region and a captionNotEqual Apple filter on Product. (A colorFilter criterion, in any form, and iMeasureHier make the web refuse the file: pivots.md.) Pivot cells are in the sidecar's `pivots` section; Q!A1 makes the case scored.
